description: FREE. Resolve a human commodity name to an instrument code — 'cocoa' to CC, 'copper' to HG, 'palm oil' to PO. Use this instead of catalog.list when you already know the commodity by name and need the code to call price.latest or trade.flow. Returns nothing rather than a guess when no instrument matches. Free discovery tool — no payment required.

q.description: Commodity name, synonym, or instrument code, e.g. 'cocoa'

name: catalog.search

available.description: False when the instrument has no resolvable source and price.latest can only fail

code.description: Instrument code to use in other tools

match.description: Why this row matched. 'code' and 'synonym' are exact and safe to act on; 'name' and 'partial' are substring suggestions worth confirming.

matched_on.description: The registry string the query hit

title: Search Instruments
